== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Restore Freedom To The Galaxy (Virtual Block 7)]] (Virtual Block 7.1), showing the '''original''' game text. No published image shows this text; the other versions of the card are [[Restore Freedom To The Galaxy (Virtual Block 7) (Errata)]] (PC-E1); [[Restore Freedom To The Galaxy (Virtual Block 7) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2); [[Restore Freedom To The Galaxy (Virtual Block 7) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3).

* '''Text source:''' Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet, first printing (official text as of 18 June 2010; not preserved): the re-made sheet's text (copy re-made 28 July 2010, [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174512/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf Internet Archive]) before the Players Committee news post "Some minor errors and clarifications" of 28 June 2010 ([https://web.archive.org/web/20100714025225/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=244:some-minor-errors-and-clarifications&catid=1:latest-news&Itemid=50 Internet Archive]).
* '''Original text:''' “Deploy on Yavin 4 system. Once per turn, may ▼ a battleground system or an interior Yavin 4 site. Whenever you Force drain at another battleground system, may draw destiny. Add 1 for each Yavin 4 site on table (2 if you occupy). If total destiny > 6, stack top card from either player's Reserve Deck face up there (limit one per system) to 'liberate' the system. At 'liberated' systems: Force drains are +1, and at same and related locations your total power is +3 and you draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. If opponent Force drains at a 'liberated' system, place stacked card in owner's Used Pile.”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71): the card's own Virtual Legacy card <code>1007_L5867</code> (printed frame, the Players Committee card image (full-art scan), title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 7 set mark) with the original game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. CardMaker's Critical Mission template does not draw the [Setup] icon on the banner.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
